description: This source file defines the 'Order' class, representing an order entity in a shopping or e-commerce application. It includes properties such as id, userId, list of CartItems, totalAmount, status, deliveryAddress, orderDate, and deliveryDate. It also provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and copying the object with modifications.
